lines.speaker: mother_aubrine
lines.text: Come in out of the draught. You need not have the right words to rest here.
lines.direction: Clear mezzo, measured and maternal; patient attention, never breathy mysticism.

options.label: We need the chapel's healing services.

lines.speaker: mother_aubrine
lines.text: Set down what hurts. We will speak plainly about the work and its cost.
lines.direction: Clear mezzo, measured and maternal; patient attention, never breathy mysticism.

lines.speaker: mother_aubrine
lines.text: Hands that tend it. Someone bringing wood when someone else cannot. Faith is not a reason to leave your neighbour cold.
lines.direction: Clear mezzo, measured and maternal; patient attention, never breathy mysticism.

lines.speaker: mother_aubrine
lines.text: Go gently. Come back if you cannot.
lines.direction: Clear mezzo, measured and maternal; patient attention, never breathy mysticism.
